tukey.source_title: Exploratory Data Analysis (1977) / NIST EDA Handbook summary
tukey.supported_principle: EDA is an open-minded approach that lets data reveal structure, anomalies, assumptions and parsimonious models before committing to a model.

wickham.supported_principle: Variables, observations, and observational units should be represented consistently; each variable is a column, observation a row, observational-unit type a table.

gelman.supported_principle: Applied modeling is iterative: model building, checking, validation, troubleshooting, understanding and comparison.

breiman.supported_principle: Prediction-focused algorithmic modeling is a legitimate alternative to relying exclusively on prespecified stochastic data models; use diverse tools to solve real problems.

zinkevich.supported_principle: Keep the first model simple, get infrastructure right, test infrastructure independently, monitor silent failures and training-serving skew.

karpathy.source_title: A Recipe for Training Neural Networks
karpathy.supported_principle: Inspect data before touching neural-net code; build simple-to-complex, make concrete hypotheses, validate each step, and expect silent training failures.

szeliski.source_title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications, 2nd ed.
szeliski.supported_principle: Treat computer vision as a problem-formulation and algorithm-selection discipline spanning image formation, recognition, geometry and learning rather than jumping directly to one architecture.

hyndman.supported_principle: Simple mean/naive/seasonal-naive methods are mandatory forecasting benchmarks; more complex methods need to outperform them.

kleppmann.supported_principle: Choose data-system technologies by reliability, scalability, maintainability and explicit trade-offs rather than buzzwords.

chip.supported_principle: Production failures can come from data/pipeline errors, distribution shift, edge cases and feedback loops; monitor raw inputs/features/predictions/performance and investigate causes.

harrell.supported_principle: Validate model assumptions and prediction processes; survival analysis must represent censoring/event information explicitly rather than treating censored time as ordinary regression target.
